name: Thaumaturgy (Mastery of the Mortal Shell) — 2 Intermediate — Body Failure

system.description: By succeeding in a Physical Challenge and spending a temporary Willpower Trait, the thaumaturge throws her target's body into total system shock, inflicting three health levels of lethal damage immediately and one more each subsequent turn until death, torpor or the power ends. Mortal victims may only bid passive Physical Traits, cannot initiate challenges, and suffer a four-Trait penalty to all actions; Kindred may attempt to soak the lethal damage. This power is lethal to mortals.
system.duration: Until death, torpor, or power ends
